result.summary: Wrote src/design/fix-ISS-0097.md. Chose direction (a): pass tenant id into the worker thread's own entry function and call tenant_context.set() as its first statement — mirroring the already-proven pattern in concurrent_instances_test.zig and iss102_claim_test.zig. Rejected (b) a pool-level explicit-tenant-id acquire() API as unjustified surface area (no call site needs it) and (c) restructuring tenant_context away from threadlocal as invasive and unmotivated (the design is deliberate per pool.zig's ISS-501 comments; no production correctness gap found in the request-handling path).
result.next_action: Route to CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR (Step 2b, self-validated inline per WF-03 scale)
